description: Estimate where a Kalshi perp position liquidates, from Kalshi’s published risk parameters: liquidation price and the % move to it (vs the 100÷leverage rule, which Kalshi’s maintenance margin makes about twice too generous), plus round-trip fees and expected funding over the hold. Kalshi caps leverage by size and side; the estimate says when it applied the cap. An ESTIMATE — Kalshi's app shows the exact figure once a position is open. Assets: btc, eth, sol, xrp, doge, hype, link, gold, silver, platinum, palladium. Free, no key. Use for "where does a 5x bitcoin long liquidate on Kalshi", "Kalshi gold perp 10x liquidation price", "how far can silver move before my Kalshi short is liquidated".

asset.description: The perp. One of: btc · eth · sol · xrp · doge · hype · link · gold · silver · platinum · palladium.

entry.description: Entry price (default: the live price). Accepts a number or a numeric string ("+150", "62%", "2.5").

hold_days.description: Days held, for the funding estimate (default 7).

leverage.description: Leverage, e.g. 5 or "5x". Capped at Kalshi’s maximum for the size and side.

margin.description: Margin in dollars (default 1000). Accepts a number or a numeric string ("+150", "62%", "2.5").

name: perp_liquidation
title: Kalshi Perp Liquidation — where a leveraged position gets closed out
